replies.body: Updated in `025e5b39`: the attached-cause test now uses Armeria’s Throwable factory when available and falls back to `initCause()` for baseline versions. HTTP/2 expectations are verified separately: baseline drops the cause; latest reports it. Baseline, latest-dependency, and Armeria 1.9 test suites pass.

Updated in `599e8b8b`: the expectation now uses `causeIsDropped`, with the requested inline expected values and comments on the HTTP/2 Armeria request-log fallback. Spotless and the affected baseline/latest HTTP/1 and HTTP/2 tests pass.

Updated in `6e45df9b`: the test now names `usesHttp2` and `usesOlderArmeria` separately, then derives `causeIsDropped` using the requested concise explanation. Spotless and baseline/latest HTTP/1 and HTTP/2 tests pass.
